notes: Identity verified internally: full PMC author-manuscript parse matching the supplied title, all five authors (Beach, Brody, Todorov, Gunter and Philibert), and DOI 10.1097/PSY.0b013e3181fdd074. Issue January 2011, online publication October 2010. Includes Methods, Results, Discussion and references; primary report, not abstract-only. No PDF supplied. Only pval_value_r assigned; other fields are unassigned placeholders. Data Analysis specifies Pearson r rather than Spearman rho. Table 1 reports sex abuse versus methylation r=.301 for the full sample and r=.329 for homozygous l women, without p-values or a significance key in the supplied table. Neither sample is selected by order or numeric matching. Parameter estimates separately reports p=.0001 for the sex-abuse-to-methylation path with other relationships controlled (exact one-tailed p-values); this is not the same test as either Table 1 Pearson correlation and is not substituted. Introductory r(82)=.360, p<.001 explicitly refers to prior work. Target sample/test remains unresolved; no p calculated from r or N. Original source is unassigned and not inspected.
